SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 28)

FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 4)
• Bedroom 1: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass/Tile Shower
• Bedroom 2: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower

SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 10)
• Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass/Tile Shower
• Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds (sleeps 8) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Shower/Tub Combo

THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 14)
• Bedroom 5: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Soaking Tub & Shower – Private Balcony
• Bedroom 6: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass/Tile Shower
• Bedroom 7: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) + Shared Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower
• Additional Space: Two Queen-over- Queen Bunk Beds (Sleeps 8)

DESCRIPTION:

‘Shore to Have Fun’ is an expansive, luxurious retreat in Seagrove Beach that’s perfect for large groups and unforgettable beach getaways. This stunning 3-story, 7-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom vacation haven comfortably sleeps 28 guests and is designed to deliver relaxation and excitement for everyone.

Upon arrival, guests are welcomed by a charming, covered porch with inviting Adirondack chairs, setting the tone for relaxation. Step inside to a cozy living area with a wet bar, oversized sectional, two armchairs, and a large TV. For those with a competitive spirit, they challenge family and friends to a game of shuffleboard or flex your pinball skills on two different machines. This floor also features two well-appointed king guest bedrooms and a convenient laundry room, complete with two full-sized washers and dryers. To top it off, an in-home elevator ensures effortless access to every level of this spacious home. Outside, the backyard oasis awaits with a private pool, relaxing spa, outdoor shower, and natural gas grill on a covered patio—perfect for al fresco dining or a sunset swim.

The second floor is an entertainer's paradise with hard wood floors, a wall of windows, and a soothing, creamy color palette that bathes the space in natural light. The main living area features two plush couches, two armchairs, and a large TV—perfect for movie nights. Adjacent to this is the dining room, where a large table seats up to 10 guests or it can be pulled apart into 2 separate tables and comfortably seats 20. The adjacent breakfast bar offers 8 additional seats. The gourmet kitchen, complete with high-end stainless-steel appliances, provides plenty of space for group cooking or enjoying a quick snack. After dinner, guests can retreat to one of the two bedrooms on this floor, a bunk room with two queen-over-queen beds or a guest bedroom with private balcony access.

The third floor houses the majority of the bedrooms, making it a peaceful sanctuary for restful nights. Here, guests will find two king guest bedrooms, a cozy bunk room with full-over-full beds, and a spacious primary bedroom with access to a private covered deck furnished with comfortable seating. A small sitting area with a couch and TV adds a touch of warmth and a perfect space to relax before bed.

The top floor is where Shore to Have Fun reaches new heights—literally! The fourth floor viewing deck offers views of the Gulf and is outfitted with alfresco dining tables and chairs, making it an ideal spot for sunset dinners or group gatherings under the stars. The expansive views and fresh ocean air make this space a guest favorite!

For even more adventure, Shore to Have Fun includes six adult bikes and a six-passenger golf cart, allowing guests to explore Seagrove Beach and iconic Seaside.
